source_message.text: While the RFP is still awaiting publication, the team is preparing everything in advance. Good morning, Nadia—RCP, the engineering firm, wants to move forward with you, and they will ask you to sign an NDA as part of that process. Once it is completed, I can send over the previous proposal and supporting documents so you can begin working on the layout, branding, resumes, and related materials. Thanks!
